item.title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen as New Free Tier and Search Model
item.description:
Google Launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen as New Free Tier and Search Model

On 12th November 2026, Google launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen, the lowest cost member of the Gemini 4 family. Designed as a high-efficiency execution engine, the model is intended for everyday work and to power AI features within Google Search.

⚙️ Key details

Google describes Hydrogen’s position in their model lineup as a tool for fast, disciplined execution.

  • Model Roles: While teams use Carbon and Argon for deep architectural judgment and designing systems, Hydrogen is built for writing code, running tests, and verifying changes.
  • Workflow Integration: Hydrogen can stand alone for everyday tasks or pair with Carbon and Argon in multi-model workflows.
  • Capabilities: In a comparison of image generation, there is a stark difference in pelican quality for Hydrogen compared to its siblings.
Model Primary Function Performance Notes
Gemini 4 Hydrogen Everyday work, code execution, free tier Intended for fast, disciplined execution
Gemini 4 Carbon Architectural judgment, untangling bugs Frontier model
Gemini 4 Argon Architectural judgment, system design Faster responses and lower token spend than Carbon

💰 Pricing

The pricing for the Gemini 4 family is scheduled to change significantly in the coming month:

  • Current Rates: Hydrogen is currently priced at a 25% discount compared to Carbon and Argon. Carbon and Argon are currently the same price.
  • Scheduled Increases: On December 1st, the price of Carbon and Argon is scheduled to double.
  • Future Discount: After December 1st, the Hydrogen price will represent a 75% discount relative to its more capable peers.
  • Market Comparison: At 15x the cost of Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6 Luna (which are both $0.10/$0.50), Hydrogen remains considerably more expensive than competing low-cost models.

🚀 Availability

Hydrogen is available immediately as the new model for Google’s free tier. It is also the specific model designated to power AI features in Google Search.

#Google #Gemini4 #ArtificialIntelligence #MachineLearning #SearchAI

Source: Release: llm-gemini 0.37

item.title: Nvidia Investigates CEO Jensen Huang Following Acknowledgment of Relationship with Suspected Chinese Agent
item.description:
Nvidia Investigates CEO Jensen Huang Following Acknowledgment of Relationship with Suspected Chinese Agent

On Sunday, Nvidia announced that its Board of Directors has initiated an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang. The investigation follows reports regarding Huang’s relationship with Alice Huang, an AI executive and agent of the Chinese government.

🔍 Overview

In a memo sent to Nvidia employees, Jensen Huang acknowledged having an affair with Alice Huang, who is identified as a suspected Chinese spy. Huang stated that he was unfaithful to his wife and that his actions hurt his children, taking full responsibility for the situation.

⚙️ Key Details

The investigation involves several key entities and concerns as outlined in company communications:

Entity Role / Description
Jensen Huang CEO of NVIDIA who acknowledged an affair with a suspected Chinese agent
Alice Huang AI executive and agent of the Chinese government
NVIDIA Board of Directors The body that initiated an independent investigation into national security concerns
  • Independent Investigation: The Board of Directors launched the probe in response to national security concerns raised in news reports.
  • Cooperation: Huang stated he supports the investigation and will cooperate fully.
  • Commitment to Security: Huang expressed his commitment to protecting NVIDIA and supporting America’s national security, noting that he is proud to be an American.
  • Professional Responsibility: Huang acknowledged that he has fallen short of his responsibility to serve the company and be worthy of trust.

💡 Why it matters

Huang described leading NVIDIA as the privilege of his life and stated he is fully committed to the company. While acknowledging that an apology cannot undo his actions, he expressed hope that he can earn back the confidence of employees over time. He also requested privacy for his family, stating they bear no responsibility for his choices.

#Nvidia #JensenHuang #NationalSecurity #AI #TechNews
